sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: Your personal data is processed by Novera Mobility as the data controller, under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law no. 6698 (KVKK).
This site belongs to a fictional company; the contact details are examples: kvkk@novera.example.

sections.heading: Personal data we process
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the site, we may process:
list: Identity and contact: first name, last name, email address, phone number.
Booking: pick-up and return location and dates, the chosen car and extras.
Corporate quote: company name, number of cars needed, rental period, car type.
Usage: your language and theme preference (through cookies).

sections.heading: Purposes of processing
list: Creating and managing your booking.
Answering your corporate quote requests.
Managing your account and keeping you signed in.
Remembering your site preferences.

sections.heading: Legal grounds
paragraphs: Your data is processed because it is directly related to the conclusion or performance of a contract, to meet legal obligations, and where necessary for our legitimate interests.

sections.heading: Sharing of data
paragraphs: Your data is not shared with third parties except where the law requires it. We may share it with our hosting and infrastructure providers only as far as necessary.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Your data is kept for as long as the purpose requires and within the maximum periods set by law, then deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Under Article 11 of the Law you have the right to:
list: Find out whether your data is processed and request information.
Learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used accordingly.
Request correction if it is incomplete or inaccurate.
Request deletion or destruction.
Claim compensation if you suffer damage.

sections.heading: How to apply
paragraphs: Send your requests to kvkk@novera.example. Applications are answered within thirty days at the latest.

sections.heading: What is a cookie?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files saved in your browser when you visit a site. They make the site work properly for you and remember your preferences.

sections.heading: Which cookies do we use?
paragraphs: Novera Mobility only uses functional cookies the site needs to work. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

cookies.name: NEXT_LOCALE
cookies.purpose: Remembers your chosen language (Turkish or English).
cookies.duration: Session: until you close the browser.

cookies.name: novera-theme
cookies.purpose: Remembers your chosen appearance (light or dark theme). It is never created if you choose the system setting.

cookies.name: Session cookie
cookies.purpose: Keeps you signed in. It is only created when you use your account.
cookies.duration: For the length of the session.

sections.heading: How can you manage cookies?
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block the language and theme cookies, your preferences reset on every visit; the site still works.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: This page is updated whenever a new cookie is added.

sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: These terms apply to car rentals made through Novera Mobility. Corporate fleet rentals are governed by the separately signed contract.

sections.heading: What we expect from the renter
list: Be at least 21 years old.
Have held a valid driving licence for at least two years.
Present an ID and the driving licence at pick-up.

sections.heading: Booking and payment
paragraphs: Every item in the booking summary is shown openly; there are no hidden fees.
The payment screen on this site is a sample: no real payment is taken and nothing is charged to your card.

sections.heading: Cancellation and changes
paragraphs: You can cancel your booking free of charge up to 24 hours before pick-up. For later cancellations, one day's rental fee may be charged.

sections.heading: Pick-up and return
list: The car is handed over at the location and time stated in the booking.
It is returned at the agreed location and time; returning to a different location must be chosen while booking.
The car is returned with the fuel level it was collected with.
Late returns are charged for the extra time.

sections.heading: Road Assurance
paragraphs: Every rental is covered by Road Assurance: a 24/7 support line, tow truck dispatch and a replacement car if a breakdown lasts more than 24 hours.

sections.heading: Liability and damage
paragraphs: The renter must drive the car in line with traffic rules and its intended use. In case of damage a report is drawn up; coverage depends on the chosen assurance package.

sections.heading: Prohibited use
list: Racing, drifting or driver training.
Subletting the car or letting third parties drive it.
Carrying commercial goods or passengers for hire.

sections.heading: Disputes
paragraphs: Disputes are first settled by good-faith discussion; if none is found, the competent courts and enforcement offices have jurisdiction.
